data.name: RichTextBox1.Text
data.value: • Table Architecture:Organizes data into two dimensions: (Rows, Columns). - Zero-indexed: row and column coordinates start at index 0. • Declaration & Total Elements: - Dim scores(2, 3) As Integer - Rows: $0 \dots 2$ (3 total) | Cols: $0 \dots 3$ (4 total) - Total Capacity: $(2 + 1) \times (3 + 1) = 12\text{ elements}$ • Accessing Elements: - Write: scores(0, 1) = 95 - Read: lblOut.Text = scores(0, 1).ToString()
